title: Better Apple Texture
description: Retexture both apples (Gold and normal) to have a small leaf to look more real
body:
Give your apples a fresh new look.
This pack slightly redesigns both the normal apple and the golden apple, making them more visually distinct while keeping the classic Minecraft style. Perfect if you want subtle improvements without changing the game’s overall feel.

More small texture tweaks are planned in future updates.
